sloka: अनयोपधया राजन् भयशोकानुबन्धया।अकामा त्वद्वशं सीता नष्टनाथा गमिष्यति ।। ६.६४.३२ ।।
transliteration: anayopadhayā rājan bhayaśokānubandhayā।akāmā tvadvaśaṁ sītā naṣṭanāthā gamiṣyati ।। 6.64.32 ।।

translations.english: "O King! By conjuring her like this, helpless Sita overtaken by fear and sorrow having lost her husband will submit to you in spite of no desire to you."
